column1: NOTE 1:The total number of interrupted slots is based on that SFN and subframe reference for per-FR gap in FR2 indicated by high layer parameter refServCellIndicator is an FR2 serving cell.NOTE 2:Slot occurs before or after the measurement gap may be interrupted additionally if SFN and subframe reference for per-FR gap in FR2 indicated by high layer parameter refServCellIndicator is an FR1 serving cell.NOTE 3:For NR SCSs of 480 kHz and 960 kHz, total number of interrupted slots on FR2-2 serving cells during MGL for NR standalone operation (single carrier, NR CA and NR-DC) with per-UE measurement gap or per-FR measurement gap for FR2-2.NOTE 4:If UE is configured with per-UE measurement gap, the MG timing advance of 0.25 is applicable only for FR2 NR SA (with both single carrier and NR CA configuration).
